tex_content.html:
Definition

For open sets $U\subseteq \mathbb R^n$ and $V\subseteq \mathbb R^m$, a map $F:U\to V$ is smooth if all component functions have continuous partial derivatives of every order. A bijective smooth map with smooth inverse is a diffeomorphism, and every diffeomorphism is a homeomorphism.
